items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: She never tell anything to me and I never say nothing to her.

ctx.x: Well, what I'm not so sure of is, what we were talking about, I kind of remember where Catherine, Basie's wife, came into the picture. And she came from the mid-west or something, didn't she?
She was from Cleveland. They used to call her Blondie Scott from Cleveland.
Really? And she was on the burlesque circuit or something.
